note: Opening hours of the quay's businesses (I026 stage 02, BusinessHours). Hours are the harbour's local solar time (Daylight.local_solar_hours), 0-24, 'open' and 'close' as decimals (7.5 = 07:30). 'closed' lists local weekdays without opening (0 = Sunday). 'regions' shift the opening and closing by the harbour's archetype (HarbourDressing.archetype_for), 'tiers' by its service tier (HarbourFacilities.get_tier). Gameplay numbers, not claims about real businesses. The harbour office's after-hours hatch is always staffed.
